objective.name: wrapper.restart
objective.description: Restart a named wrapper in the current context. Stops the current process then starts it again and waits for readiness.

#root.role: Stop the named wrapper, wait for it to stop, then start it again via ensureWrapperReady, and emit a response.

name._comment: Required. Name of the wrapper to restart.

payload._comment: Empty payload on success. The wrapper has been stopped and restarted, and is ready when the response is received.

effects.wrapper_runtime: The wrapper process is stopped then restarted. Build artifacts may be refreshed if source changed.

transformation_contract.morphing: A restart request becomes a freshly started, ready wrapper process.
invariants: params.name must refer to a wrapper declared in execution config.
The handler runs asynchronously — it does not block the execution inbox.
Stop is performed first; start is only attempted after the wrapper process has exited or the stop timeout has elapsed.
success: Emits an OK response with empty payload when the wrapper is ready after restart.
failure: Emits an error response when the wrapper name is missing or not configured.
Emits an error response when the restart build or start process fails.
